description: The plot illustrates the accuracy of two experiments, Ex1 and Ex2, as a function of training steps. The x-axis is labeled “Step” and is a linear scale ranging from 0 to 60000, with tick marks every 10000 units. The y-axis is labeled “Accuracy (Next Token Prediction)” and is a linear scale ranging from 0.10 to 0.40, with tick marks every 0.05 units. A blue line represents “Ex1 Accuracy,” marked with circular data points; it begins at approximately 0.11 at a step of 0, rises sharply to 0.38 at a step of 10000, and then plateaus around 0.39 between steps 20000 and 60000. A cyan line represents “Ex2 Accuracy,” also marked with circular data points; it starts at approximately 0.10 at a step of 0, increases to 0.27 at a step of 10000, continues to rise to 0.34 at a step of 20000, and then levels off around 0.36 between steps 30000 and 60000.
